question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**carried**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is written in the **past tense**, as seen in the phrase "*The last one of this long procession was a little wizened old man*."
 
• Therefore, the verb in blank (2) must also be in the **past tense** to maintain consistency in narration.
 
• Among the given options, "**carried**" is the correct past tense form of "*carry*."
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is: "*Even he carried a load of two baskets, slung on a pole on his shoulder.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1 – carried**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **carries:** Present tense – does not fit the past narrative of the passage.
 
• **carry:** Base form of the verb – grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• **carrying:** Continuous form – would require an auxiliary verb (e.g., “was carrying”).
